description:
[Admin]

Lists the company's media library: images, MP4 video, audio and WOFF2 fonts for career pages. Use a file's `url` in page blocks, brand logos and font settings. A sub-company also sees its parent's files, marked `read_only`. Files still uploading are not listed. Images, video, audio and fonts already stored in the company's folder (logos, blog and cover images, earlier uploads) are added to the library on the first list.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

folder.description: Only files in this library folder. Send an empty value for the top folder.

include_parent.description: Also list the parent company's files, read only, when this company is a sub-company. Default true.

kind.description: Only files of this kind: image, video, audio or font.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1–1000).

merchant_id.description: Optional merchant to scope to. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's merchant.

offset.description: Number of records to skip from the start of the result set.

search.description: Only files whose name contains this text.

name: List_the_media_library

data.description: Files that finished uploading, newest first.

alt.description: Alt text per language code, such as {"en": "Our team"}.

duration_seconds.description: Length of a video or audio file in seconds, as sent to media-upload-finish.

folder.description: Library folder; "" is the top. It is the directory of the file in storage.

height.description: Height in pixels, as sent to media-upload-finish.

merchant_id.description: Company whose library holds the file.

path.description: Object name in the public bucket: <merchant_id>/[<folder>/]<file>.

poster_url.description: Still image shown before a video plays.

read_only.description: True for a file of the parent company's library: it can be used on pages but not changed or deleted.

size_bytes.description: Size of the file in bytes, measured after the upload.

status.description: uploading until media-upload-finish accepts the file, then ready.

url.description: Public address of the file, served by the CDN. It changes when the file is replaced.

version.description: Goes up each time the file is replaced.

width.description: Width in pixels, as sent to media-upload-finish.

has_more.description: True when more records exist beyond this page (offset + returned < total).

limit.description: Page size used for this response.

total.description: Total matching records across all pages.

title: Media List
